snippet.title: UBAI: To Take Another Man's Property - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Take your pick between following Asami or Tsubaki in this exciting visual novel. Skip text you’ve already read with a handy skip button or enjoy the story with the auto button. Choose your story with differing endings and see how it concludes.

UBAI: To Take Another Man's Property on Kagura Games Store: https://www.kaguragames.com/product/ubai-to-take-another-mans-property/
